description: This file defines the QueryEngine_LlamaIndex class implementing a query engine using LlamaIndex, with methods for initialization and running queries, including streaming support and engine preparation logic.

classes.name: QueryEngine_LlamaIndex
classes.description: Implements a query engine integrating LlamaIndex, capable of handling streaming responses and source document formatting.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the QueryEngine_LlamaIndex with optional sessionId and sets default properties.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Prepares the engine based on node data.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a query, supports streaming responses, and returns either text or source documents.
